text: July 2026: we cleaned a side pergola at a Currumbin Waters home. Dark mould and grime had built up on the beam ends and rafters beside the path. After the clean, the beams and the white lattice were fresh and bright again.
alt: Before and after of the side pergola beam ends beside path. Before: Pergola beam ends and rafters with dark mould and grime, next to white l in Currumbin Waters
